dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 16, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Dominant Performances Highlight Day's MLB Action**

A trio of impressive home runs highlighted the day's action, with Javier Sanoja's 5th homer propelling the Miami Marlins to a 7-1 win over the Cincinnati Reds. Sanoja's 5th homer was one of three hits in four at-bats, also driving in three runs. Meanwhile, Alec Bohm's 2-hit performance included a 4-RBI homer, helping the Philadelphia Phillies secure a 7-5 victory over the Minnesota Twins.

In pitching performances, Trevor Rogers was nearly unhittable, striking out 6 over 6 innings and allowing just 2 earned runs in the Baltimore Orioles' 10-2 win over the Tampa Bay Rays. Dylan Cease also turned in a strong outing, fanning 10 over 6.1 innings in the New York Yankees' 4-3 win over the Toronto Blue Jays.

Noah Cameron delivered a complete-game shutout, striking out 8 over 9 innings in the Kansas City Royals' 3-0 win over the Los Angeles Angels.
